preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of pairs of interesting vertices k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n and xi != yi for xi, yi in pairs)
preconditions.description: Each pair of interesting vertices (xi, yi) must be valid indices within the range of vertices and must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k lines, one for each pair of interesting vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 1000000007 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == count_paths(pairs[i]) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: Each output line must correspond to the number of distinct simple paths between the respective pairs of vertices.
